recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C, E during 19:00-20:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of 14 St; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
